# P34.42b — least-privilege runtime identities (remove project Editor) — the 88 jobs + `roles/editor` removal

**Requirement ids:** **Owner (spec §56):** SIG-SEC-007 (with P34.42a;
this half: the jobs and the Editor removal). **Cited (context, owned
elsewhere):** SIG-STORE-048 (writers never hold object-delete — P37.3,
also P34.3), SIG-OPS-005 (scheduler of record — P35.1a), SIG-SEC-009
(secret lifecycle — P35.4). **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/252_P34.42b__least-privilege-job-identities-remove-editor.md`
(manifest row 252, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.42a-least-privilege-service-identities` (stacked, H2 PR-1) ·
**Gate:** the S5-3 11A list names "P34.42a/b (IAM)" — pre-authorised
(expires GATE-G4; voided-by a red probe, a failed restore point, or a
production read that contradicts a record) · **Live stage:** production
write (IAM: job-class SAs, bindings, job/trigger identity updates, then
`roles/editor` removal) — **queued exit 42, not executed** (AR-3 + AR-2
window: the first slot ≥ 2026-10-13T12:00Z, never 03:00–06:30Z,
never while a job of the affected class is running; re-run with the
contract's verbatim prompt, scope the jobs IAM leg only) · **CI config
changed:** no.

## Why

Every one of the 88 Cloud Run jobs — plus the services until P34.42a —
runs as the project-Editor default compute identity (G1-01 / F-272,
the dominant runtime security risk): a compromised ingest parser, API
or scheduler path could delete the claim spine, the evidence stores
and every secret. SIG-SEC-007 forbids workloads on basic roles.
P34.42a moved the three services; this half moves all 88 jobs onto
job-class identities, moves scheduler invocation onto a dedicated
invoker SA, and removes `roles/editor` from the default compute SA —
closing G1-01.

## What ships

- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — the `sig.iam-identities/1`
  declaration extended: four job-class runtime SAs
  (`sig-ingest-rt`, `sig-probe-rt`, `sig-export-rt`,
  `sig-materialize-rt`) with least-privilege grants (`cloudsql.client`;
  `objectCreator` + `objectViewer` on the restricted bucket for ingest
  — **no `objects.delete`**; the ONE conditioned grant,
  `roles/storage.objectUser` scoped to `objects/evidence/captures/`
  only — ADR-201), four reserved identities (`sig-quality-probe-rt`,
  `sig-release-rt`, `sig-status-rt`, `sig-scheduler`) created
  grant-less until their rows land, the `[[job_class]]` map resolving
  all **88** jobs (cadence `sources`/`batches`/`probes` + explicit
  exceptions — the G1-17 cruft probes included, deleted later by
  P35.1b), `[[job_invoker]]` putting `sig-scheduler` on the 79
  scheduled triggers, the two-leg `[[invoker]]` rules for `sig-alerts`
  (interim `default-compute` → end-state `sig-probe-rt`),
  `[[remove_role]] roles/editor` on `default-compute`, and
  `jobs_revoke` secret-matrix members (the compute SA's job-only
  accessors are desired-absent under the jobs leg; it keeps
  `sig-pg-password` for the GCE host/break-glass path).
- **`ops/src/ops/iam_identities.py` + `sig-ops iam`** — the engine
  grows the new tables with fail-closed validation (a basic role, a
  public grant, an undeclared SA, a multiply-claimed or unclaimed job,
  a condition on a non-conditionable role or off the captures prefix
  each refuse), the cadence-vs-explicit job-map resolver with an
  `expected_job_count` coverage refusal, `--leg services|jobs|all` on
  `plan`/`diff`, conditioned bindings in both plan and diff, job +
  scheduler snapshot fields, and the same-image gate extended to job
  describes.
- **`ops/gcp/iam-job-identities.sh`** — the windowed leg
  (dry-run-by-default): `prestate` (project/bucket/secret IAM + all 88
  job describes + trigger describes + the live job re-count — a count
  or coverage disagreement refuses) → `identities` → `bindings`
  (grants + `jobs_revoke` removals) → `jobs` (88 same-image
  `--service-account` updates behind a fail-closed "no execution of
  the class running" guard) → `invokers` (the 79 triggers onto
  `sig-scheduler`; `sig-alerts` onto `sig-probe-rt`) → `editor` (the
  `roles/editor` removal — LAST, refused while anything still runs as
  the compute SA) → `verify`/`analysis` (`sig-ops iam diff --leg jobs`
  + same-image gate + policy-troubleshooter incl. the off-prefix
  delete probe — GRANTED is a hard fail) → `rollback` (the recorded
  prestate). `--apply` is ADC-gated AND window-gated AND
  execution-gated: exit **42** inside the freeze or the daily band or
  while an affected job runs, with the verbatim re-run prompt; check
  mode makes zero network calls; `--verify [--from-state DIR]` is the
  read-only diff.
- **Deploy paths** — `scheduled-ops.sh` (probe + per-source ingest +
  replay), `export.sh`, `materialize.sh`, and `sig-ops job-roll`
  (`--service-account`, fail-closed on an unmapped job) all pass the
  identity explicitly (AR-8); `config.sh` carries the `SIG_SA_*` /
  `SIG_IAM_JOBS_*` constants.
- **Docs & records** — ADR-201 (the conditioned captures-prefix
  grant), its Appendix F row + revisit-trigger register row + BL-084
  mapping, `D-P34.42b-1` (the standing review for P37.3, with the
  `e0` obligation-event anchor), and the `ops/gcp/README.md` row.

## Boundaries

**No production mutation ran or runs in this PR** — the jobs IAM leg
is queued: apply inside the freeze (or the 03:00–06:30Z band, or while
a job of the class runs) exits 42 naming the verbatim re-run command
`implement-spec
spec=docs/tickets/252_P34.42b__least-privilege-job-identities-remove-editor.md
live_verification=true` (scope: the jobs IAM leg only). `roles/editor`
stays on the default compute SA until the leg's LAST step. No secret
value is read, copied or committed — the declaration carries names and
IAM references only. No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick,
no spine UPDATE/DELETE, `db/sqitch.plan` 44–52 untouched, no
living-record assertion, no e-mail address anywhere.

Out of scope held: cruft-job deletion (P35.1b — the egress probes get
probe-class grants meanwhile), the scheduler of record (P35.1a),
capture-store retention + a dedicated evidence bucket (P37.3 — it
inherits `D-P34.42b-1`), DB logins and the execution host (P34.43).
